item.title: 11 Million Impacted by Capcom Data Breach
item.description: The hackers stole 11 million email addresses from CAPCOM ID and changed the login passwords for 196 accounts. The post 11 Million Impacted by Capcom Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Quest Diagnostics Reports Cyber Breach Affecting ‘Certain Patient Records’
item.description: In a regulatory filing, Quest Diagnostics reported unauthorized access to its Quanum Lab Services Manager, a platform where certain clients can place test orders. The post Quest Diagnostics Reports Cyber Breach Affecting ‘Certain Patient Records’ appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: LiteLLM Compromised in Fresh Supply Chain Attack
item.description: Hackers used compromised GitHub CLI OAuth tokens to push and approve malicious packages on PyPI and Docker. The post LiteLLM Compromised in Fresh Supply Chain Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Atlassian Patches 75 Flaws in Data Center and Server Products
item.description: Atlassian’s October bulletin lists 176 vulnerability entries, including 14 critical-severity issues, all in third-party components. The post Atlassian Patches 75 Flaws in Data Center and Server Products appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: USTB Team Uses Deep Reinforcement Learning to Redesign Robotic Butterfly Wings
item.description: A University of Science and Technology Beijing team used deep Q-learning on 95 real flights of USTButterfly-II to redesign flapping wings, lifting its lift performance parameter by 339 percent.

item.title: HiSilicon Backs NearLink SLE 3.0 Evolution Blue Paper at CEIC 2026 in Shenzhen
item.description: At CEIC 2026, Shanghai HiSilicon cast OpenHarmony, NearLink, on-device AI and media as four edge ecosystems as the SparkLink Alliance released a NearLink SLE 3.0 evolution blue paper.

item.title: MOSI and OpenMOSS Open-Source MOSS-Image, a 5B Model Built for Text and Layout Control
item.description: MOSI Intelligence and OpenMOSS open-sourced MOSS-Image, a 5B text-to-image model focused on dense text and JSON layout control that quickly topped Hugging Face's text-to-image trending list.

item.title: Huawei Spells Out CANNLab, CANNBot and CANNJudge as Its Open Ascend Developer Base
item.description: At GOSIM Shenzhen 2026, Huawei detailed CANNLab free cloud environments, the multi-agent CANNBot assistant and CANNJudge challenges as the working base of its open Ascend CANN stack.

item.title: Alibaba's Qoder Adds Loongson LoongArch Support Alongside UOS and Kylin Desktops
item.description: Alibaba's Qoder coding agent now runs on Loongson LoongArch64 as well as Linux ARM64, with builds for UnionTech UOS Desktop V20 and Galaxy Kylin Desktop V10.

item.title: Iran’s Prince of Persia APT Hosts C&C in US for First Time Since 2016
item.description: After a three-month lull, Prince of Persia hid a Tornado C&C server on US shared hosting, its first US-based server since 2016. The post Iran’s Prince of Persia APT Hosts C&C in US for First Time Since 2016 appeared first on SecurityWeek.
